title: r2c.workflow/v1
description: Declarative workflow manifest (workflows/<name>.yaml). This file is the documented source of truth for the manifest shape; src/manifest.js implements the same rules by hand so the runner needs no JSON Schema runtime dependency. Every structural violation becomes an entry in errors[] as {path, code, message}.
$comment: Semantic rules not expressible (or only partly expressible) in JSON Schema, all reported in one pass by src/manifest.js: stage ids unique among stages (DUPLICATE_STAGE_ID); step ids unique across the whole manifest (DUPLICATE_STEP_ID); taskFile must exist relative to the manifest root (TASKFILE_MISSING); expect.outputs entries must be syntactically valid globs (GLOB_INVALID) and must not target skills/** or any SKILL.md (OUTPUT_FORBIDDEN); a missing singular `skill` is a warning only (SKILL_MISSING) and never fails validation; `agent` is prompt metadata and is not validated; `stages` and each `steps` must be non-empty (EMPTY); prompt steps require non-empty prompt text or taskFile (PROMPT_SOURCE_MISSING); shell steps require shell and timeout (SHELL_REQUIRED, TIMEOUT_REQUIRED) and must not carry prompt/taskFile (PAYLOAD_CONFLICT); gate[].command must be non-empty (GATE_COMMAND_EMPTY).

schema.description: Manifest schema revision. An unsupported value is MANIFEST_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED (exit 2).

id.description: Stable workflow id, recorded in state.json as workflow_id.

version.description: Workflow authoring version (independent of the runner package version).

stages.description: Ordered stages; every stage embeds its steps.

id.description: Unique across the whole manifest; used by submit --step.

type.description: prompt steps are delivered to the agent; shell steps are executed by the runner under timeout.

agent.description: Rendered into the prompt as the role hint only; never validated and never dispatched.

skill.description: Primary skill name; resolved as skills/<skill>/SKILL.md under the manifest root. Missing file warns (SKILL_MISSING) but does not fail.

taskFile.description: Prompt payload file path relative to the manifest root; must exist (TASKFILE_MISSING). Prompt steps only.

prompt.description: Inline prompt text. Prompt steps need this or taskFile.

shell.description: Command executed by the runner (never handed to the model). Shell steps only.

timeout.description: Seconds. Required for shell steps; optional elsewhere.

input.description: Opaque step input passed through by the runner; not interpreted by validation.

skills.description: Skill whitelist rendered into the prompt.

mcp.description: MCP whitelist rendered into the prompt.

subagent.description: Rendered as a hint only; v1 never dispatches subagents.

gate.description: Run in order by submit; any non-zero exit refuses the submission.

outputs.description: Globs (relative to the project root) that must exist before submit succeeds. Each item must be a syntactically valid glob (GLOB_INVALID) and must not target skills/** or any SKILL.md (OUTPUT_FORBIDDEN).

command.description: Shell command run by the runner with cwd = project root; empty is GATE_COMMAND_EMPTY.
